summary: Verify c8 --plan reproduces the 36 frontier l1-v3 span ids identically
description:
EARLY KILL GATE. Deterministic, costs no GPU, and invalidates the whole benchmark if it fails — so run it before spending any generation budget.

Run: scripts/backup_db.sh pre-c8-local-bench, then build_dossiers.py --plan --db ~/guru-backups/guru-<ts>-pre-c8-local-bench.db

The c8 plan must produce span ids for iamblichus-on-the-mysteries, egyptian-heaven-and-hell and apocryphon-of-john byte-identical to the c7 rows already in staged_summaries at prompt_version='l1-v3', status='accepted' (36 rows). Needs the schema/config from the previous two tickets.

DONE: a diff of c8 planned span ids against those 36 c7 summary_ids is empty, and the span-plan artifact is committed. If it is NOT empty, STOP and close this as the answer — the pairing is broken and the benchmark cannot proceed as designed.
